text:
tom_infra: afternoon async standup — GPU fleet / provisioning / quotas

what I did: validated the new reservation flow for aws-us-west-2, exercised autoscale policy on staging, pushed small fix to slot allocator.
blockers: still seeing 'permission denied' when creating capacity reservations in gcp-us-central1 (service account lacks compute.reservations.create).
today: follow up with infra-iam, coordinate fallback to reserved A100 pool if quota request delayed.

sara_devops: saw a spike in eu-west1 pod pending yesterday around 11:30 UTC. raised support ticket with cloud provider — ticket #14287. provider says A100 stock low, suggested trying other zones or committing reservations. :frowning:

maya_sre: @tom_infra fyi the gcp service account is missing the Role: roles/compute.admin on the project used by private deployments. that's why `compute.reservations.create` fails. I can patch it but need an owner token to bind the role.

cheng: opened PR for the reservation retry backoff (link: https://git.redwood.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/298). small change, adds exponential backoff + jitter. would appreciate a quick review before I merge.

capacity-bot: automatic snapshot (1772103600):
```
region    | total_gpus | allocated | available | pending_requests
us-west-2 | 240        | 230       | 10        | 4
us-central1| 192       | 180       | 12        | 7
eu-west-1 | 120        | 118       | 2         | 6
ap-southeast1| 56      | 55        | 1         | 2
```
note: eu-west-1 has low spare capacity, recommend delaying non-critical batch jobs or routing to us regions.

tom_infra: thanks all. next steps: @maya please escalate with infra-ops for owner token (if you can't get it by EOD i'll open a ticket). @cheng i'll review PR in next 30m. @sara can you try a soft-fallback to us-west-2 for the queued jobs and post results here?

sara_devops: will do a quick route test now and post results. if fallback works i'll update the job scheduler rule to prefer us-west-2 for batch windows. :thumbsup:

maya_sre: starting owner token escalation. ETA 2 hours.

cheng: thanks — pinged you @tom_infra for review. adding unit test for the backoff.

tom_infra: small note — avoid making manual reservations in eu-west-1 until we decide on commitment levels. we should avoid overspending on speculative reservations.

sara_devops: understood. i'll run the fallback test and report.

capacity-bot: quota alert: one quota request in progress for eu-west-1 (14290). estimated approval ETA 48h if linear.

tom_infra: ok, keep this thread updated. i'll follow up in the infra-sync channel if anything requires synchronous action. :eyes:
